reviewed_by: docs/go-no-go-arbitrage.md. The v2 pairs below are DUST: listed as venues so the scanner can measure them, not because they are tradeable. Traded and referee v3 pools come from the signer allowlist, so this file only adds venues the allowlist does not name.
impact_buffer_note: First-slice placeholder. Price impact is not yet computed from in-range liquidity; this conservative buffer stands in until exact impact via exactInputSingle simulation replaces it. Rationale for the number: the go/no-go measured impact < 0.01% at $100 on liquid pools, so 0.1% (10 bps) is a deliberately wide floor that never lets a dust pool read as executable.
lp_rebalance_note: What the LP sync loop proposes when a position is out of range: a new +/-5% range around the current tick (symmetric in price, snapped to the pool's tick spacing) sized for the position's current USD value, with a 0.5% slippage floor on the mint amounts. Proposals only — nothing executes them yet.
lp_harvest_note: The exact fee accrual (feeGrowthInside, the number collect() pays) at which an in-range position gets a harvest proposal. On this chain a collect costs a fraction of a cent of gas, so this is about avoiding dust transactions and proposal churn, not gas. A position accruing $0.50 may take days at a $500 size; raise or lower it deliberately, in this file.
